build.scope: Playable Pallet Town opening with integrated Pokedex; limited starter practice rules.

browser_checks: game SRAM import/export and wrong-format isolation
limitations: Three level-5 starters and five supported practice moves
Full battle mechanics, difficulties, AI, wild capture and growth not integrated
Background music and full animation not implemented
native_test_note: Initial native C tests passed; Windows application control later blocked the regenerated EXE. Final build runs the same C test source as Wasm plus actual ARM ROM in mGBA.
